items.name: apm-atlassian
items.description: Team collaboration for APM through Confluence, Jira and Bitbucket.
items.readme:
# apm-atlassian

A team customization of [APM](https://github.com/sdi2200262/agentic-project-management). Review the Spec and Plan in Confluence, then claim Stages in Jira. Hand off to another teammate between Stages and share APM session documents through Bitbucket.

Start APM from the root of the separate Bitbucket repository for APM files.

```text
workspace/
  my-project/       # Working repository
  my-project-apm/   # Bitbucket repository and APM session root
    .git/
    .apm/
    .agents/        # Or .claude/ for Claude Code
```

Set up [Atlassian MCP](https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-ai-gateway/docs/get-started-with-the-atlassian-remote-mcp-server/) in each assistant. Once a release is available, install the team's assistant targets in the session root.

```sh
apm custom -r sdi2200262/apm-atlassian
```

items.name: passync
items.description: Zero-Disk-Plaintext, 3-Way Password Manager Synchronizer for macOS (iCloud Passwords <-> Google Password Manager)
items.readme:
# passync

**Zero-Disk-Plaintext, 3-Way Password Manager Synchronizer for macOS (`iCloud Passwords` ↔ `Google Password Manager`).**

`passync` is a lightweight native **Rust + Tauri v2 macOS Menu Bar application** (and companion CLI) that keeps **Apple Passwords (iCloud Keychain)** and **Google Password Manager (Chrome)** in sync with full **3-way merge detection** (additions, password updates, and deletions) while ensuring **not a single byte of plaintext password ever touches your SSD**.

---

## Architecture

1. **`crates/passync-core`**:
   - `model`: Canonical credential normalization (`(host, port, username)`), `Zeroizing<String>` memory guards, and round-trip `OTPAuth` preservation.
   - `state`: Zero-knowledge SQLite state database using a 256-bit HMAC key stored in the macOS login Keychain (`com.galaxous.passync.state-key`) and keyed `BLAKE3` hashes.
   - `merge`: Deterministic 12-case 3-way merge engine handling additions, single-sided password/metadata updates, single-sided deletions, and true modify-modify / modify-delete conflicts.
   - `chrome`: Direct discovery and in-memory AES-128-CBC (`v10`) decryption of Chrome's `Login Data` and `Login Data For Account` databases via macOS Keychain `"Chrome Safe Storage"`, plus direct SQLite deletion when Chrome is closed and deep-link generation.
   - `apple`: Apple Passwords CSV reader/writer (`Title,URL,Username,Password,Notes,OTPAuth`) and macOS Passwords.app deep links.
   - `ramdisk`: Ephemeral `hdiutil` + `diskutil` HFS+ RAM disk mounted at `/Volumes/PassyncRAM` (`chmod 700`) with automatic file zeroization and force-unmount on drop.
   - `watcher`: Real-time `notify` (`FSEvents`) watcher monitoring Chrome SQLite databases without polling or cron jobs.
2. **`crates/passync-cli`**:
   - Command-line interface for headless inspection, status checks, RAM-disk lifecycle testing, and 3-way diffing.
3. **`crates/passync-app` & `ui/`**:
   - Native macOS Menu Bar app built with **Tauri v2** and **React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS**, providing a Visual Diff & Merge Review window before applying any change.

---

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- macOS 13+ (Ventura, Sonoma, Sequoia, or newer)
- Rust toolchain (`cargo`, `rustc`)
- Node.js 20+ (for building the Tauri frontend in `ui/`)

### Run Tests
```bash
cargo test --workspace
```

### Run CLI
```bash
# Inspect Chrome profiles & live diff status
cargo run -p passync-cli -- status

# Run interactive 3-way diff with ephemeral RAM disk
cargo run -p passync-cli -- sync
```

### Run Menu Bar App
```bash
cd ui && npm install && npm run build
cargo run -p passync-app
```

---

## License
MIT

items.description: Modular submarine simulation: 6-DOF hydrodynamics, 17 interacting subsystems (propulsion, ballast, sonar, TMA, damage control, ...) and a live 3D viewer with PyQt5 dock panels. Each subsystem is a plug-in module on a shared signal bus, so it is easy to extend.
items.readme:
# Submarine Toolbox

Modular submarine simulation: 6-DOF hydrodynamics, 17 interacting
subsystems (propulsion, ballast, sonar, TMA, damage control, ...) and a live
3D viewer with PyQt5 dock panels. Each subsystem is a plug-in module on a
shared signal bus, so it is easy to extend.

![Main window: chase camera with HUD, ship-state plots, helm panel and broadband sonar waterfall](docs/figures/gui_overview.png)

## Features

- **Fossen 6-DOF dynamics** with RK4 at 50 Hz; ballast, trim, flooding and
  control surfaces all feed the equations of motion.
- **Unbounded world.** The seafloor is a deterministic procedural field
  (banks, ridges, seamounts); terrain streams in around the boat, traffic is
  recycled around own ship, and the 3D view uses a floating origin, so you can
  sail anywhere.
- **Acoustics and sensors.** Passive/active sonar equations, layer effects,
  baffles and towed array, own-ship signature, radar/ESM, INS + GPS, and
  bearing-only target motion analysis.
- **Casualties.** Compartment flooding and fire, hydraulics leaks, battery
  load shedding, atmosphere control, endurance.
- **Cockpit-style UI.** Keyboard helm with autopilot or manual control, HUD
  with compass tape, depth gauge and alerts, contact labels, four camera
  modes, and an in-app help overlay (H).
- **Fast.** About 90 µs per sim step, so time compression up to ×100.

![Chase camera with HUD: nav block, compass tape, depth gauge with layer/test/crush/seafloor marks](docs/figures/chase_hud.png)

## Install

Python ≥ 3.9.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/gaschenb/Submarine-Toolbox.git 
cd Submarine-Toolbox
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install -e .
```

## Run

```bash
submarine-toolbox
# or
python -m submarine_toolbox.main
```

Click the 3D view so it has keyboard focus, then press **H** for controls.

## Controls

Helm keys drive autopilot orders, or the raw actuators in manual mode
(M switches between them without a jump).

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| W / S | speed ±1 kn (manual: shaft rpm ±10) |
| A / D | heading ∓5° (manual: rudder) |
| R / F | rise / fall 10 m (manual: planes) |
| Shift + W S A D R F | ×5 step |
| 1 – 4 | depth preset 15 / 40 / 100 / 200 m |
| X | all stop |
| L | hold current course and depth |
| M | autopilot ⇄ manual |
| P | active sonar ping |
| T | towed array deploy / recover |
| U / N | periscope / snorkel up-down (periscope depth only) |
| G | GPS fix (needs a mast at periscope depth) |
| Ctrl+B | emergency blow |
| Space | pause / resume |
| [ / ] | time compression down / up (×1 – ×100) |
| C / V | cycle camera (chase / orbit / top / free) / reset camera |
| K | contact labels on / off |
| F2 / F11 | hide panels / fullscreen |
| H or F1 / Esc | help overlay / close help and refocus the 3D view |
| Mouse | drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, Ctrl-drag to pan |

All subsystem controls are also available in the dock panels (View menu).

![In-app help overlay (H), generated from the same keymap the shortcuts use](docs/figures/help_overlay.png)

## Architecture

```
submarine_toolbox/
├── core/
│   ├── simulation.py        # fixed-timestep engine (RK4), shared bus
│   └── subsystem.py         # Subsystem base class (update + tau)
├── dynamics/
│   ├── vessel.py            # notional ~1500 t SSK parameters
│   └── rigid_body.py        # Fossen 6-DOF: M ν̇ + C ν + D ν + g(η) = τ
├── subsystems/
│   ├── propulsion.py        # shaft lag, Kt/Kq prop model, cavitation flag
│   ├── power.py             # battery SOC, hotel load, diesel/snorkel charge
│   ├── ballast.py           # MBT, variable ballast, trim, HP air, emerg. blow
│   ├── control_surfaces.py  # rate-limited rudder + stern planes
│   ├── autopilot.py         # speed-scheduled heading/depth/speed hold
│   ├── environment.py       # SVP, current, sea state, bathymetry sampling
│   ├── contacts.py          # ambient traffic, recycled around own ship
│   ├── signature.py         # own radiated SL + counter-detection radius
│   ├── sonar.py             # passive suite (baffles, towed array), active
│   ├── atmosphere.py        # O2/CO2 balance, scrubbers, O2 gen + bank
│   ├── masts.py             # mast interlocks, surface radar, ESM
│   ├── navigation.py        # INS drift model + GPS fixes at PD
│   ├── tma.py               # bearing-only TMA (Levenberg-Marquardt)
│   ├── damage.py            # compartments, flooding, fire, crush depth
│   ├── hydraulics.py        # plant pressure, leaks, actuator dependency
│   ├── comms.py             # VLF wire / SATCOM mast, broadcast schedule
│   └── endurance.py         # diesel fuel, provisions, fresh water
├── world/
│   └── bathymetry.py        # hashed value-noise fBm seafloor, unbounded
└── gui/
    ├── main_window.py       # docks, menus, keymap wiring, paced sim loop
    ├── controls.py          # keymap (single source) + command controller
    ├── hud.py               # QPainter HUD, compass, depth gauge, help
    ├── viewer3d.py          # GL: streamed terrain, floating origin, cams
    └── panels/              # ship_control / acoustics / tactical / ship_systems
```

## Dynamics and world

Fossen 6-DOF model (M ν̇ + C(ν)ν + D(ν)ν + g(η) = τ) integrated with RK4;
the autopilot closes heading, depth and speed loops on it. Heading and pitch
loops invert the rudder/plane lift (~u²), so the closed-loop response is the
same from 3 to 18 kn. Depth commands a vertical rate (limited by plane
authority, with anti-windup), and below ~6 kn variable ballast takes over
the share the planes cannot deliver, so depth changes work down to a hover.

![Autopilot step responses: heading, depth with pitch, speed](docs/figures/autopilot_response.png)

The seafloor is a hashed value-noise fBm field with seamounts, evaluated on
demand anywhere, so there is no map edge. Grounding, keel clearance and the
terrain-ahead warning use it.

![Procedural bathymetry with a 2.5 h track and the depth profile under the keel](docs/figures/bathymetry_track.png)

## Simulated Systems

**Damage control.** Five compartments (FWD/CONTROL/MACHINERY/ENGINE/AFT).
Breaches flood at Cd·A·sqrt(2g·depth); bilge pumps derate with depth
(150 m head limit); open WT doors equalize flooding into neighbours.
Flood weight and pitch moment feed the 6-DOF dynamics — a large breach
at depth genuinely requires speed, lightening, and possibly an emergency
blow, and can be unrecoverable. Fires need O2, dump CO2 into the
atmosphere model, and accumulate equipment damage (engine room ->
propulsion limit, machinery -> atmosphere equipment). Beyond crush depth
the hull starts failing with progressive breaching; the procedural
seafloor (mean 480 m, banks and seamounts) grounds the boat.

**Hydraulics.** Plant pressure bleeds with control-surface activity and
recovers on the (electric) pump. Leaks drain fluid until isolated; one
reserve refill. Low pressure slows plane/rudder slew and freezes masts.

**Comms.** Shore broadcasts every 10 min. VLF floating wire receives
(delayed) down to 50 m; the comms mast at PD gives two-way traffic and
drains the outbox. Missed-broadcast count is the discipline metric.

**Endurance.** Diesel fuel burns with generator output (SFC 0.22 kg/kWh)
and gates snorkel charging; crew consumes food and fresh water; the
distiller replenishes water while powered. Bilge pumps add a noise
component to the acoustic signature.

**Atmosphere.** Crew O2 consumption / CO2 production against hull volume;
electrolytic O2 generator, scrubbers, emergency O2 bank, and free
ventilation when surfaced or snorkeling. Equipment draws electrical load
and honors load shedding. CAUTION/DANGER thresholds.

**Electrical.** Consumers publish `load.*` [W]; the plant sums them with
propulsion and hotel load. Bus voltage sags with SOC and current
(V = OCV(SOC) − I·R). Below 10% SOC non-vital loads shed automatically.

**Masts, radar, ESM.** Masts (periscope/ESM/radar/snorkel) auto-house
below 18 m. The surface-search radar detects surface contacts to the
4/3-earth radar horizon but is ESM-detectable by capable contacts at
~1.5x that range. Own ESM passively intercepts contacts' navigation
radars — bearing, emitter class, strength.

**Navigation.** INS position error grows as a velocity-bias random walk;
GPS (any raised mast at PD) snaps it back to ~5 m, automatically or on
demand.

**TMA.** Bearing-only target motion analysis on the tracked passive
contact: batch Levenberg-Marquardt fit of a constant-velocity solution
over multiple range-hypothesis initializations, using INS positions and
measured (noisy) bearings. Own-ship leg changes are required for range
observability; solution quality is honest about it (with a two-leg
geometry at ~10 km the range typically lands within a few percent).

![Two-leg bearing-only TMA: solution after each leg and error vs time](docs/figures/tma_two_leg.png)

## Acoustics model

Sonar equations with hybrid spreading TL = 20 log r (r ≤ 1 km) +
10 log r/1 km beyond, plus absorption and a 12 dB cross-layer penalty:

    passive:  SNRx = SL − TL − NL + DI − DT
    active:   SNRx = SL_ping − 2·TL + TS − NL + DI − DT

NL power-sums ambient (sea-state dependent) with own self-noise derived
from the signature subsystem — running quiet directly extends your own
detection ranges. Hull arrays are baffled ±30° astern; deploying the
towed array removes the baffle and adds 3 dB DI. Bearing/range
measurement noise scales inversely with SNR. Active pings publish a
counter-detection radius (everyone hears you). The Signature panel shows
the component breakdown (machinery/flow/cavitation/snorkel/blow) and an
estimated counter-detection range against a nominal threat sensor.

**Conventions.** SNAME/NED: body x fwd, y stbd, z down; depth positive.
Positive rudder → starboard turn; positive planes → nose up. MBT fill
1.0 = flooded (submerged trim), 0.0 = blown (surfaced).

**Signal bus.** `sim.bus` is a flat dict. Orders (`order.*`), actuator
commands (`cmd.*`), and telemetry (`propulsion.*`, `power.*`,
`ballast.*`, `state.*`). Panels write orders; subsystems read commands
and publish telemetry; dynamics reads mass properties from
`ballast.weight/xg/zg`.

## Adding a subsystem

```python
from submarine_toolbox.core.subsystem import Subsystem

class Sonar(Subsystem):
    name = "sonar"
    def update(self, dt):
        self.put("sonar.contacts", [...])
    # def tau(self): ...   # only if it exerts forces
```

Register with `sim.add(Sonar)`, add a panel in `gui/panels/`, dock it in
`main_window.py`.

## Headless use

```python
from submarine_toolbox import Simulation
from submarine_toolbox.subsystems import build_default_boat
import numpy as np

sim = build_default_boat(Simulation())
sim.bus["order.depth"] = 100.0
sim.bus["order.heading"] = np.radians(90)
sim.bus["order.speed"] = 4.0
sim.step(30000)   # 600 s at dt=0.02
print(sim.bus["state.depth"], sim.eta)
```

## Roadmap

- Scenario scripting / mission generator; save-load of sim state
- Convergence-zone & bottom-bounce propagation; narrowband sonar + demon lines
- Periscope visual model; contact AI reactions (evasion, counter-detection responses)

All coefficients are notional (plausible magnitudes for a small SSK), not
identified from any real hull.

items.name: cibersecurity-desafio-malware-python
items.readme:
# Simulando Malware de Captura de Dados em Python

Desafio prático da DIO (Tech Expert: Isadora Ferrão) — trilha de Cybersecurity. Este projeto tem fins **estritamente educacionais** e demonstra, em ambiente 100% controlado, o funcionamento básico de duas ameaças comuns: Ransomware e Keylogger, além de abordar as respectivas medidas de defesa.

> ⚠️ **Aviso:** Nenhum dos scripts deve ser executado fora de um ambiente de testes isolado. O objetivo é entender o ataque para construir defesas melhores.

## 🎯 Objetivos de Aprendizagem
- Compreender o funcionamento prático de Ransomware e Keylogger;
- Programar scripts simples em Python simulando ataques reais;
- Identificar como esses malwares exploram vulnerabilidades;
- Refletir sobre estratégias de defesa e prevenção.

## 🛠️ Tecnologias Utilizadas
- **Python 3**
- `cryptography` (Fernet) para criptografia simétrica (Ransomware)
- `pynput` para captura de teclado (Keylogger)
- `smtplib` (simulação de exfiltração de dados por e-mail)

## 🚀 Como Executar os Testes

### 1. Ransomware Simulado
O script criptografa um arquivo de teste e gera uma chave de descriptografia.
```bash
cd src
echo "Este é um arquivo de teste" > teste.txt
pip install cryptography
python ransomware.py
# O arquivo teste.txt será criptografado e a chave.key será gerada.

# Para reverter:
python decrypter.py
```

### 2. Keylogger Simulado
Captura as teclas digitadas e salva em um arquivo local.
```bash
cd src
pip install pynput
python keylogger.py
# Digite algumas coisas no terminal e feche com Ctrl+C. Verifique o log.txt.
```

## 🛡️ Reflexão sobre Defesa e Mitigação
Para se proteger contra essas ameaças no mundo real, as seguintes camadas de segurança são fundamentais:

- **Antivírus e EDR:** Detectam comportamentos anômalos, como a criptografia em massa de arquivos ou a interceptação de teclado (hooks).
- **Firewall e Segmentação de Rede:** Impedem a comunicação do malware com servidores de Comando e Controle (C2) externos, bloqueando a exfiltração de dados.
- **Sandboxing:** Executar arquivos suspeitos em ambientes isolados para análise antes de comprometer o sistema principal.
- **Conscientização do Usuário:** A brecha humana é a mais explorada. Não clicar em links suspeitos ou baixar anexos de remetentes desconhecidos evita a infecção inicial.
- **Backups Offline:** A única defesa garantida contra Ransomware. Mantenha cópias de segurança desconectadas da rede.

## 📂 Estrutura do Repositório
- `src/`: Contém os códigos (ransomware.py, decrypter.py, keylogger.py).
- `images/`: Pasta para capturas de tela dos testes.
- `README.md`: Documentação do projeto.

## 🔗 Referências
- Curso DIO - Simulando Malware em Python
- Cryptography Documentation
- Pynput Documentation

items.name: discord-verify
items.description: Verificação de membros por OAuth2 para bots discord.py — anti-spam, anti-alt e anti-raid (email, IP, VPN, lista negra)
items.readme:
# discord-verify

Verificação de membros para bots **discord.py** contra spam, contas fake, alts de banidos e raids.

Quem entra no servidor só vê o canal de verificação. A pessoa aperta **Verificar**, entra com o Discord
(OAuth2) e o bot confere o email, o IP, a localização e se ela usa VPN. Se estiver tudo certo, ela ganha o
cargo verificado na hora. Se algo parecer estranho, o caso vai para a staff decidir com um botão:
**Banir**, **Liberar** ou **Analisar**.

## O que ele detecta

| Alerta | Quando dispara |
|---|---|
| IP banido | Mesmo IP de alguém já banido. No IPv6, compara o bloco /64, porque o final do endereço muda sozinho. |
| Email banido / parecido | Email igual ou parecido com o de um banido (`joaosilva` × `joaosilva2`). No Gmail, ignora pontos e `+tag`. |
| Email descartável | Domínio de email temporário (lista com mais de 100 mil domínios, atualizada toda semana) ou domínio que você bloqueou. |
| Sem email / não verificado | Conta do Discord sem email, ou com email não confirmado. |
| VPN / proxy / datacenter | IP de VPN, proxy ou hospedagem (via [ip-api.com](https://ip-api.com)). |
| IP compartilhado | Outra conta se verificou do mesmo IP nos últimos 30 dias. |

Além disso:

- Quando alguém é **banido por qualquer meio**, o IP e o email dele entram sozinhos na lista negra. Assim, a
  conta alternativa cai na verificação.
- **Dois níveis de privacidade:** o canal de logs mostra email e IP completos (só para o dono). O canal de
  suspeitos mostra tudo mascarado (`j***a@gmail.com`, `189.45.*.*`) para a staff.
- O botão **Analisar** abre um canal privado (pessoa + staff) e salva a conversa nos logs quando é fechado.
- Os dados são apagados depois de 90 dias, menos os de contas banidas.

## Como funciona

```
membro ──► #verificação ──► botão "Verificar" ──► página (seu domínio, HTTPS)
                                                    │  login OAuth2 do Discord (identify + email)
                                                    ▼
                                    bot: email + IP + geolocalização/VPN + lista negra
                                          │                         │
                                     tudo limpo                  suspeito
                                          ▼                         ▼
                                  cargo Verificado       #suspeitos: Banir · Liberar · Analisar
```

A página roda **dentro do próprio bot** (aiohttp, em `127.0.0.1:8095`). Você só precisa expor essa porta com
HTTPS: Cloudflare Tunnel, nginx ou Caddy.

## Instalação

### 1. Developer Portal

Em <https://discord.com/developers/applications>, abra a aplicação do seu bot:

1. **Bot → Privileged Gateway Intents:** ligue **Server Members Intent**.
2. **OAuth2:** copie o **Client ID** e gere/copie o **Client Secret**.
3. **OAuth2 → Redirects:** adicione `https://verify.seudominio.com/callback`, trocando pelo seu domínio.

### 2. Servidor do Discord

1. Crie o cargo **✅ Verificado**.
2. Arraste o **cargo do bot para cima** do cargo Verificado. Se não fizer isso, o bot não consegue dar o cargo.
3. Crie os canais:
   - `#verificação`: `@everyone` só lê. É aqui que vai o painel.
   - `#verify-logs`: só o dono vê (email e IP completos).
   - `#suspeitos`: só a staff vê.
4. Bloqueie o resto para quem não é verificado. Em cada categoria, tire **Ver canal** de `@everyone` e dê
   **Ver canal** para **✅ Verificado**.

O bot precisa das permissões **Gerenciar cargos**, **Gerenciar canais**, **Banir membros** e **Ver registro
de auditoria**.

### 3. Colocar no seu bot

Copie a pasta `verify/` para dentro do projeto do bot, instale as dependências
(`pip install -r requirements.txt`) e carregue a extensão:

```python
intents = discord.Intents.default()
intents.members = True                 # obrigatório

class Bot(commands.Bot):
    async def setup_hook(self):
        await self.load_extension("verify")
        await self.tree.sync()         # registra /verify e /blacklist
```

Preencha as variáveis de ambiente a partir do `.env.example`. Se o bot já usa `python-dotenv`, basta
acrescentar as linhas no `.env` dele. Para testar isolado antes de mexer no seu bot, rode o `example_bot.py`.

### 4. HTTPS

Exemplo com Cloudflare Tunnel (o padrão `VERIFY_IP_HEADER=CF-Connecting-IP` já é para ele):

```yaml
# ~/.cloudflared/config.yml
ingress:
  - hostname: verify.seudominio.com
    service: http://127.0.0.1:8095
  - service: http_status:404
```

Com nginx ou Caddy, use `VERIFY_IP_HEADER=X-Real-IP` e repasse esse cabeçalho no proxy.

> **Importante:** deixe a porta 8095 escutando só em `127.0.0.1`. Se ela ficar aberta na internet, qualquer
> pessoa pode forjar o cabeçalho de IP.

### 5. Usar

No `#verificação`, rode `/verify panel`. Pronto.

## Comandos

| Comando | Quem | O que faz |
|---|---|---|
| `/verify panel` | admin | Posta o painel com o botão **Verificar** no canal atual. |
| `/verify info @pessoa` | dono | Mostra as últimas verificações da pessoa (email, IP, local, alertas). |
| `/blacklist add ip\|email\|domain <valor> [motivo]` | dono | Bloqueia um IP, email ou domínio. |
| `/blacklist remove …` | dono | Tira da lista. |
| `/blacklist list` | dono | Mostra a lista negra. |

## Configuração

Todas as variáveis estão comentadas no [`.env.example`](.env.example). As obrigatórias são:
`DISCORD_CLIENT_ID`, `DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET`, `VERIFY_URL`, `VERIFY_GUILD_ID`, `VERIFY_ROLE_ID`,
`VERIFY_LOG_CHANNEL_ID` e `VERIFY_SUSPECT_CHANNEL_ID`.

Os dados ficam em `data/verify.db` (SQLite, permissão 600). **Não suba essa pasta para o GitHub.** Ela já está
no `.gitignore`.

## Privacidade (LGPD / GDPR)

O bot guarda email, IP e localização aproximada de quem se verifica. A página tem um aviso em `/privacy`
explicando o que é coletado, para quê e por quanto tempo. Avise isso também no servidor e atenda pedidos de
remoção. Os dados servem só para proteger o servidor: não use para outra coisa.

O plano gratuito do ip-api.com aceita 45 consultas por minuto e é só para uso não comercial. Para um servidor
grande ou comercial, troque `GEO_URL` em `verify/intel.py` por um serviço pago.

## Testes

```bash
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
pytest
```

## Licença

MIT

items.name: antigravity-offline-translator
items.description: Optional local offline English-to-Chinese NMT engine for antigravity-plus using CTranslate2 int8 and Windows JobObject CPU/RAM limits.
items.readme:
# Antigravity Offline Translator

面向 **[antigravity-plus](https://github.com/derrickLL/antigravity-plus)** 的可选本地离线英译中神经机器翻译（NMT）扩展包，也可作为任何桌面 AI 工具的通用低开销本地离线翻译后端。

> **是否需要安装本仓库？**
> - 如果你的电脑日常保持联网，**仅安装 `antigravity-plus` 主仓库即可**（主仓库自带高速在线多路翻译与自动故障切换，零 Python 依赖、开箱即用）。
> - 如果你需要在**完全断网、纯内网隔离或所有在线翻译通道均不可用**的环境下继续实时翻译 AI 的英文思考过程（Thought）与会话标题，安装本扩展包即可自动激活断网离线兜底。

---

## 核心特性

1. **零常驻内存与按需唤醒**：平时后台 **0 进程驻留、0 内存占用**；仅在在线接口全部不可用时按需拉起，空闲 3 分钟后自动销毁进程释放内存。
2. **Windows JobObject 内核级资源硬限流（`ResourceHost.exe`）**：
   - 使用 Windows 原生 JobObject 将离线推理子进程硬性限制在 **最高 25% CPU 占用**、`BelowNormal` 调度优先级与 **`max(5% 物理内存, 800MB)` 内存上限**内；
   - 开启 `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE`，宿主退出时 100% 杜绝僵尸 `python.exe` 残留。
3. **CTranslate2 `int8` 量化高速 CPU 推理与中文路径兼容**：基于 Argos Translate / OpenNMT `translate-en_zh-1_9`（约 70MB，严格校验官方 SHA-256），采用内存直读 `SentencePiece` 模型字节与兼容中文/非 ASCII 路径加载策略，自动保护 `[C0]` 代码/路径占位符与 `[P0]` 专业术语占位符，并内置中文标点间距精修。
4. **安全原子重装与白名单卸载**：重复安装或模型更新时先在临时目录下载、验签并校验通过后再原子替换旧模型（断网或校验失败绝不破坏原有可用模型）；卸载严格校验 `deployment.json` 归属并仅删除本扩展包自建目录与文件，保留同目录内的其他用户文件。
5. **自动关联 `antigravity-plus`**：一键安装完成后自动将引擎路径注册至 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityPlus\config.json`（若后装 `antigravity-plus`，主程序也会自动识别默认安装路径 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityOfflineTranslator`）。

---

## 环境要求

- **操作系统**：Windows 10 / Windows 11 (x64)
- **Python**：已安装 Python 3.9 ~ 3.13 且加入系统 `PATH`（无需安装 Visual Studio，C# 资源宿主使用 Windows 系统自带 `.NET Framework csc.exe` 自动编译）
- **首次安装网络**：首次运行安装脚本需联网拉取 `ctranslate2`、`sentencepiece` 与约 70MB 模型权重包（支持自动识别系统代理）；安装完成后运行阶段 100% 纯离线（`HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`）。

---

## 一键安装与卸载

### 一键安装
双击仓库根目录的 **`Install.cmd`**，或在终端执行：

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install.ps1
```

可选参数：
- `-InstallDir "D:\CustomPath\AntigravityOfflineTranslator"`：指定自定义安装目录（默认安装至 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityOfflineTranslator`）。
- `-ProxyUrl "http://127.0.0.1:7897"`：显式指定首次下载模型使用的 HTTP 代理（默认自动探测系统代理并在失败时回退直连）。

### 一键卸载
双击仓库根目录或已安装目录的 **`Uninstall.cmd`**，或执行：

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Uninstall.ps1
# 如安装到了自定义目录，可指定 -InstallDir：
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Uninstall.ps1 -InstallDir "D:\CustomPath\AntigravityOfflineTranslator"
```

> **安全边界**：卸载脚本会先校验目标目录中的 `deployment.json` 部署回执，并仅删除本扩展包创建的 `ResourceHost.exe`、`translation-worker.py`、`venv`、`model-package`、`deployment.json`、`Uninstall.cmd`、`scripts\Uninstall.ps1` 等白名单项；若你在同一目录下存放了其他无关文件，卸载时会完整保留，绝不误删。

---

## 与 `antigravity-plus` 联动说明

安装完成后会在目标目录生成 `deployment.json` 回执文件。`antigravity-plus` 在以下任一条件下会自动启用离线兜底：

1. 安装在默认路径 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityOfflineTranslator`（自动探测，无需手改配置）；
2. 或在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityPlus\config.json` 中指定自定义路径：

```json
{
  "translation": {
    "mode": "hybrid",
    "offlineRoot": "C:\\Users\\<YourName>\\AppData\\Local\\AntigravityOfflineTranslator"
  }
}
```

也可以在 Antigravity 界面内的 **Antigravity Plus 设置面板** 中随时将翻译模式切换为：
- `hybrid`（推荐：在线高速优先 + 断网离线兜底）
- `online`（仅使用在线通道）
- `offline`（强制全程使用本地离线模型）

---

## 独立协议调用（供其他工具复用）

读取 `deployment.json` 后，按以下参数启动进程并通过标准输入输出（JSON Lines）通信：

```text
<resourceHost> <python> <worker> <modelRoot>
```

- **启动就绪信号（`stdout` 首行）**：`{"type": "ready", "computeType": "int8", "threads": 4}`
- **发送批量翻译请求（写入 `stdin` 一行 JSON）**：
  ```json
  {"id": 1, "texts": ["Inspecting [C0] token refresh flow."]}
  ```
- **返回翻译结果（`stdout` 一行 JSON）**：
  ```json
  {"id": 1, "texts": ["正在检查[C0]令牌刷新流程。"], "elapsedMs": 115}
  ```
- **资源遥测信号（`stderr`，可选消费）**：`ResourceHost.exe` 会向 `stderr` 输出 JobObject 限额（`limits`）与周期用量（`usage`）JSON；内置非阻塞有界缓冲队列（调用方即使忽略 `stderr` 也不会死锁），如需记录遥测可直接按行读取 `stderr`。

运行自检测试：

```powershell
node .\tests\smoke-test.cjs
```

## License

MIT

items.description: All-in-one modular enhancement suite for Google Antigravity on Windows: Codex theme, live context/throughput/quota widgets, flagship model lock, mouse gestures, thought/title translation, proxy/Fastpush fix, and interactive toast center.
items.readme:
# Antigravity Plus (`antigravity-plus`)

面向 **Google Antigravity (Windows)** 的模块化增强套件。采用 **0 字节无损原生引导层（Shim V3）** 架构，在不破坏官方 `app.asar` 归档与签名的前提下，一站式集成极简桌面主题、三大实时状态微件、新对话最高旗舰模型自动锁定、鼠标侧键与四向右键手势、Thinking 与对话标题流式中文化、右下角无抢焦交互式任务通知/一键权限审批，以及进程级网络与外部浏览器路由修复。

**全部 15 项功能与 3 种翻译模式均支持随时独立开启或关闭**，可视化开关毫秒级实时生效。

---

## 一、功能模块一览（全部支持随时独立开/关）

| 分类 | 配置键 (`features.*`) | 默认 | 实时生效 | 功能说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **界面与微件** | `codexTheme` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | ChatGPT / Codex 极简桌面排版主题、高对比度代码块与 900px 宽屏阅读列 |
| **界面与微件** | `contextRing` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | 输入框右下角三色上下文圆环（0–59% 翠绿 / 60–79% 琥珀橙 / ≥80% 珊瑚红），支持免点击悬停预览（140ms 跨缝缓冲）、点击固定与 `Token breakdown` 明细 |
| **界面与微件** | `performancePill` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | 实时任务阶段计时（`Thinking` / `Generating` / `Executing`）与 `Avg tok/s` 输出速率胶囊，支持免点击悬停预览与点击固定 |
| **界面与微件** | `quotaSplitRing` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | 侧边栏左下角高对比度加粗双半环配额指示器（上半环 `5h` / 下半环 `Weekly`），独立轨道底槽与悬停重置提示 |
| **交互与模型** | `autoHighestModel` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | 仅在空白新对话自动选择最高阶旗舰模型与最高推理档位（手动切换后当次会话绝不覆盖） |
| **交互与模型** | `navigationGestures` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | 鼠标侧键（前进/后退）与按住右键四向拖拽手势（`←` 返回、`→` 前进、`↑` 到顶、`↓` 到底） |
| **交互与模型** | `newWindowMenu` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | 在顶部 `Window` 下拉菜单提供 `New Window (Ctrl+Shift+N)`，配合任务栏右键新建窗口与 `--new-window` |
| **实时中文化** | `thoughtTranslation` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | `Thinking` 思考展开正文实时流式中文化，完整保护代码路径与命令行参数，支持一键对照原文 |
| **实时中文化** | `titleTranslation` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | 侧边栏会话列表与顶栏英文标题自动中文化，鼠标悬停查看中英双语标题 |
| **弹窗与网络** | `taskToast` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | 右下角原生无抢焦任务完成提醒、`ask_question` 单选/多选直接作答与后台零切窗权限审批 |
| **弹窗与网络** | `externalBrowser` | 开启 | 即时 (0ms) | 拦截外部 `http/https` 链接并优先使用 Chrome（或系统默认浏览器）新建标签页打开 |
| **弹窗与网络** | `localProxy` | 开启 | 下次启动生效 | 仅在进程内存作用域注入本地回环代理（或自动继承系统 WinINET 代理）并清理异常 `NODE_OPTIONS` |
| **弹窗与网络** | `fastpushFix` | 开启 | 下次启动生效 | 为代理环境下的 `language_server.exe --standalone` 自动注入 `--remote_agent_fastpush_override=false` 防止流式断连 |
| **工作流规则** | `chineseExecutionRule` | 开启 | 即时同步文件 | 自动在 `~/.gemini/config/rules/` 同步或移除 `agy-plus-chinese-execution.md`（默认简体中文执行与回复） |
| **工作流规则** | `workspaceScriptsRule` | 开启 | 即时同步文件 | 自动在 `~/.gemini/config/rules/` 同步或移除 `agy-plus-workspace-local-scripts.md`（禁止 C 盘临时目录散落脚本） |

---

## 二、一键安装与一键卸载

### 环境要求
- **操作系统**：Windows 10 / Windows 11（x64）
- **客户端**：已安装 Google Antigravity（默认路径 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\antigravity`）
- **零额外运行时依赖**：
  - 使用 Windows 系统自带的 PowerShell 5.1 与内置 `.NET Framework csc.exe` 编译右下角原生通知宿主；
  - 若电脑未安装独立 Node.js，脚本会自动回退使用 `Antigravity.exe` 内置运行时（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`），开箱即用。

### 一键安装
1. 克隆或下载本仓库后，直接双击运行根目录下的 **`Install.cmd`**。
2. 如需指定代理端口、自定义目录或接管旧版引导脚本，可在终端传入可选参数：
   ```powershell
   .\Install.cmd -ProxyUrl "http://127.0.0.1:7897"
   ```
   完整安装参数（传给 `Install.cmd` 或 `scripts\Install.ps1`）：
   - `-InstallRoot <路径>`：自定义独立运行时目录（默认 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityPlus`）。
   - `-AntigravityResourcesDir <路径>`：自定义客户端 `resources` 目录（默认 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\antigravity\resources`）。
   - `-GeminiConfigDir <路径>`：自定义 `~/.gemini/config` 目录（默认 `$HOME\.gemini\config`）。
   - `-ProxyUrl <URL>`：指定本地回环代理（默认自动读取或继承系统代理）。
   - `-OfflineTranslatorDir <路径>`：指定配套离线翻译引擎目录。
   - `-CleanLegacy` / `-LegacyLaunchDir <路径>`：明确授权接管旧版 Shim / 同名 Toast 插件与旧版规则，并在接管前自动将原文件备份至 `<InstallRoot>\backup\`（未传 `-CleanLegacy` 时遇未知 Shim 或同名插件会前置拦截，零文件覆盖）。
   - `-AllowMissingClient`：仅部署运行时与配置，跳过客户端 `app.asar` 校验（通常仅用于预部署）。
   - `-SkipRegistryRun` / `-SkipScheduledTask` / `-NoStartWatcher`：跳过开机自启、计划任务注册或立即启动守护进程。
3. 安装脚本会自动将运行时部署至目标目录并写入 `install-receipt.json` 绑定客户端路径，即使后续移动或删除下载的源码文件夹也不会影响运行。原地升级前会自动停止当前安装目录的旧版 `TaskToastHost.exe` 与 `watch.cjs` 进程，避免残留锁死文件。

### 一键卸载（100% 恢复官方原版）
- 直接双击仓库目录或**已安装目录**（例如 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityPlus` 或自定义 `-InstallRoot`）下的 **`Uninstall.cmd`**。在自定义安装目录内直接双击 `Uninstall.cmd` 或 `Manage.cmd` 时，脚本会自动识别所在目录的 `install-receipt.json` 并作用于该实例。
- 卸载程序会严格校验 `install-receipt.json` 的目录绑定与 `resources\app` 归属（拒绝误删任何无关用户文件），随后移除打开窗口中的前端增强组件、关闭右下角弹窗宿主、清理开机守护与计划任务、删除写入的 Hook 插件与规则文件，并将 `app.real.asar` 原封不动还原回 `app.asar`。
- 若当初使用 `-CleanLegacy` 接管过旧版插件或规则，默认卸载会自动将备份的原插件与规则还原；同时默认保留 `<InstallRoot>\backup\` 备份目录以保障可回溯。
- 卸载可选参数（传给 `Uninstall.cmd` 或 `scripts\Uninstall.ps1`）：
  - `-KeepConfigAndCache`：保留 `config.json` 与标题翻译缓存。
  - `-NoRestoreLegacy`：卸载时不自动还原 `-CleanLegacy` 备份的旧版插件与规则。
  - `-PurgeBackups`：连同 `<InstallRoot>\backup\` 一并清理。
  - `-SkipSystemRegistration`：跳过注册表与计划任务清理。

---

## 三、如何随时开启或关闭任意功能

安装完成后，你有 **3 种方式** 随时独立控制每一项功能：

### 方式 1：客户端内可视化开关面板（推荐）
通过以下任意入口即可呼出 **Antigravity Plus 功能控制中心**：
- 点击侧边栏左下角的 **调节滑块图标**（即使关闭了所有主题和圆环，该入口始终保留）；
- 点击顶部菜单栏 **`Window -> Antigravity Plus Settings…`**；
- 按下快捷键 **`Ctrl + Shift + ,`**。

面板内提供全部 15 个独立开关、**「混合加速 / 仅在线 / 仅离线」** 三段式翻译引擎切换器，以及底部的 **「全部开启」 / 「全部关闭（原版模式）」** 一键切换按钮。修改后立即持久化至 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityPlus\config.json` 并同步到所有打开的窗口。

### 方式 2：交互式终端菜单与命令行（`Manage.cmd`）
- **图形化数字菜单**：直接双击 **`Manage.cmd`**，输入序号 `1`–`15` 即可切换对应功能开关，输入 `M` 切换翻译引擎模式，输入 `P` 修改本地代理地址。
- **命令行快捷指令**：
  ```powershell
  .\Manage.cmd status                        # 查看桥接状态与当前窗口注入情况
  .\Manage.cmd config                        # 查看当前完整配置与离线模型探测状态
  .\Manage.cmd disable codexTheme            # 立即关闭 Codex 主题恢复原版配色
  .\Manage.cmd enable codexTheme             # 立即开启 Codex 主题
  .\Manage.cmd toggle thoughtTranslation     # 切换 Thinking 实时中文化开关
  .\Manage.cmd set-mode online               # 切换翻译模式：hybrid | online | offline
  .\Manage.cmd set-offline-root "D:\Custom\Translator"  # 自定义或清空离线翻译引擎目录
  .\Manage.cmd set-proxy http://127.0.0.1:7897
  ```

### 方式 3：直接编辑 `config.json`
直接修改 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityPlus\config.json` 中的布尔值，运行中的客户端会在 1.5 秒内自动感知并热同步。

---

## 四、翻译引擎架构与可选离线模型包

`Antigravity Plus` 的实时中文化采用 **多级自动容灾管线**：
1. **默认在线极速通道（无需额外安装任何模型）**：
   - **第 1 级**：Google Chrome 词典批量通道（`clients5.google.com`，单次并发打包整段句子，延迟最低）；
   - **第 2 级**：阿里达摩院 NMT 直连通道（`translate.alibaba.com`，国内免代理直连毫秒级响应，自动续期 CSRF 凭证）；
   - **第 3 级**：Google GTX 备用通道（`translate.googleapis.com`）；
   - 任意通道出现超时或 `429` 限流时自动进入 45–120 秒冷却并无缝降级至下一通道，同时内置 AI/深度学习术语精修（如保护 `PyTorch`、`ONNX Runtime`、`Antigravity` 不被误译，修正 `DDP 培训 -> DDP 训练` 等）。
2. **第 4 级本地离线神经机器翻译兜底（可选独立仓库）**：
   - 若你处于纯离线内网环境，或希望在所有在线通道不可用时拥有 100% 本地兜底，可搭配安装配套仓库 **[`antigravity-offline-translator`](https://github.com/derrickLL/antigravity-offline-translator)**（基于 Windows JobObject 硬件级 25% CPU 限额 + `CTranslate2 int8` 离线模型）。
   - 安装 `antigravity-offline-translator` 后，`Antigravity Plus` 会自动识别 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityOfflineTranslator\deployment.json`，无需手动配置路径；若未安装离线包，保持默认的 `hybrid` 或 `online` 模式即可零报错正常使用。

---

## 五、全局与客户端文件改动透明清单

为保证工程透明度与可审计性，以下完整列出 `Install.cmd` 在本机创建或调整的全部文件与系统项（**绝不修改系统级/用户级 `HTTP_PROXY` 环境变量，绝不解包重打包官方 `app.asar`**）：

### 1. Antigravity 客户端目录（`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\antigravity\resources\`）
- **`app.asar` -> `app.real.asar`**：将官方原始归档重命名为 `app.real.asar`（二进制内容 0 字节改动）。
- **新增 `app\package.json`**：同步官方版本号并将入口指向同目录的 `index.js`。
- **新增 `app\index.js`**：30 行轻量引导脚本（标记为 `ANTIGRAVITY_PLUS_SHIM_V3`），启动时先加载 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityPlus\src\core\runtime.cjs`，随后无缝移交回 `../app.real.asar/dist/main.js`。

### 2. 独立运行时目录（`%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityPlus\`）
- **`config.json`**：保存全部 15 个功能开关、代理地址、外部浏览器路径与翻译模式。
- **`bin\TaskToastHost.exe`**：安装时由本机 `.NET Framework csc.exe` 从源码 `src\toast\TaskToastHost.cs` 与 `NativeApproval.cs` 现场编译生成的右下角原生 WinForms 弹窗宿主（透明可审计，无预编译黑盒二进制）。
- **`bin\Start-Watcher.vbs` / `bin\Ensure-Shim.vbs`**：无黑框后台静默守护启动脚本。
- **`cache\title-translations.json`**：本地会话标题中英映射缓存（避免重复请求翻译接口）。

### 3. Antigravity Agent 插件与全局规则目录（`~/.gemini/config/`）
- **新增插件 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/task-completion-toast/`**：
  - `plugin.json`：声明 `Antigravity Plus Toast Hook` 插件元信息。
  - `hooks.json`：注册 `Stop` 事件钩子（统一调用 `run-on-stop.cmd`，优先使用本机 Node.js，无独立 Node.js 时自动回退 `Antigravity.exe` + `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`），用于在后台会话完成时即使窗口未激活也能立即推送右下角通知卡片。
  - `on-stop.cjs` & `run-on-stop.cmd`：轻量转发器，读取 `config.json` 中的 `features.taskToast` 开关并唤醒 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AntigravityPlus\src\toast\on-task-stop.cjs`（当你在面板中关闭「右下角任务弹窗」时，该钩子会直接静默退出）。
- **可开关全局工作流规则 `~/.gemini/config/rules/`**：
  - **`agy-plus-chinese-execution.md`**（受 `features.chineseExecutionRule` 开关控制，关闭即自动从 `rules` 目录移除）：约束 Agent 默认使用简体中文撰写执行说明、任务进度与回复，同时保留代码、路径与命令原文。
  - **`agy-plus-workspace-local-scripts.md`**（受 `features.workspaceScriptsRule` 开关控制，关闭即自动从 `rules` 目录移除）：禁止 Agent 将临时辅助脚本写入 C 盘系统临时目录或 `.gemini\...\scratch\`，统一收敛至当前项目工作区的 `scripts/` 或 `.tmp/` 目录，减少跨盘权限弹窗。
  - > **关于交互式弹窗规则的说明**：右下角弹窗对 `ask_question`（单选/多选问题）及权限审批的捕获完全通过主进程与前端状态树自动完成，无需手动修改工作流提示词；Agent 正常调用官方内置的 `ask_question` 工具时，若窗口处于后台，右下角会自动弹出可点击选项卡片。

### 4. 自启动与自动更新防覆盖项
- **当前用户注册表启动项**：`HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\AntigravityPlus`（登录后静默运行 `watch.cjs` 命名管道守护进程）。
- **Windows 计划任务**：`Antigravity-Plus-Guard`（登录时及每 5 分钟执行一次毫秒级快速校验，当 Antigravity 静默自动升级生成新 `app.asar` 时自动同步版本号并重建引导层）。

---

## 六、常见问题与排障

1. **安装或卸载提示客户端占用 `app.real.asar`（退出码 `3`）**：
   - Windows 不允许在 `Antigravity.exe` 正在加载 `app.real.asar` 时重命名归档。请先完全退出 Antigravity（含系统托盘），再重新双击 `Install.cmd` 或 `Uninstall.cmd` 即可。
2. **安装时提示已有旧版 Shim 或同名 `task-completion-toast` 插件**：
   - 为避免无意覆盖第三方或其他自定义方案，安装器默认拒绝覆盖并保持原目录 0 改动。确认需要接管并自动备份旧文件时，执行 `.\Install.cmd -CleanLegacy` 即可。
3. **非管理员账号下计划任务注册被跳过**：
   - `Install.ps1` 会尝试以普通用户权限注册登录触发与每 5 分钟触发的 `Antigravity-Plus-Guard`；若受企业组策略限制无法创建计划任务，安装器会给出提示并继续完成核心部署，客户端内置的自动更新重建助手仍会生效。
4. **电脑未安装独立 Node.js 时的行为**：
   - `Install.ps1`、`Manage.ps1`、`Check-CloudPermissions.ps1` 与 Stop Hook（`run-on-stop.cmd`）都会自动切换至 `Antigravity.exe` 内置运行时（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`）；开机自启守护在无独立 Node.js 模式下以 `--once` 单次预热运行后自动退出，绝不常驻锁死 `Antigravity.exe` 阻碍官方更新。
5. **代理与云端权限回环排障**：
   - 在终端运行 `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Check-CloudPermissions.ps1`（支持自定义安装目录自动识别），可检查 `language_server` 回环配置、代理端口连通性与 `fastpushFix` 状态。

---

## 七、开发与自动化测试

```powershell
# 1. 编译右下角通知宿主
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\src\toast\Build-TaskToast.ps1

# 2. 运行全量单元与端到端自动化测试（18 大测试套件 + 故障注入 + 双仓库隐私可移植性扫描）
npm test

# 3. 诊断当前运行中客户端的本地代理与云端权限回环状态
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Check-CloudPermissions.ps1
```

# The Funniest Sick-Day Excuse

[![make.fun](https://make.fun/badge/u-zeroxfive-the-funniest-sick-day-excuse-37423a36.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/u-zeroxfive-the-funniest-sick-day-excuse-37423a36)
[![Rank](https://make.fun/badge/u-zeroxfive-the-funniest-sick-day-excuse-37423a36/masoplek1011/u-zeroxfive-the-funniest-sick-day-excuse-37423a36/rank.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/u-zeroxfive-the-funniest-sick-day-excuse-37423a36)
[![Reward](https://make.fun/badge/u-zeroxfive-the-funniest-sick-day-excuse-37423a36/masoplek1011/u-zeroxfive-the-funniest-sick-day-excuse-37423a36/reward.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/u-zeroxfive-the-funniest-sick-day-excuse-37423a36)

One line, under 200 characters, that someone could text their boss to call in
sick — a slept-wrong neck, and a twist right at the end.

Run it with Node 22:

```sh
MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/out node main.ts
```

It writes the single excuse line to `$MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR/entry.txt`,
deterministically, every time.
